cases.rationale: Clean disk, violating proposal: unresolved import is in the proposed source, not on disk; manifest is present and contains no such dependency.
Violating disk, clean proposal: stale unresolved import in the existing file must not be attributed to the proposed replacement.
A new source path whose parent does not exist must be evaluated from the proposal, without creating that parent or source file.
A declared external dependency resolves the proposed import; context includes a package manifest.
A stated project convention forbids unwrap on untrusted parsed input; the proposed function violates it.
A compliant parse implementation respects the same convention; the risky existing helper is not the proposal.
The proposed function has nested branches and loops even though the existing helper is simple; complexity is assessed for proposed code.
Existing complex function is unchanged; proposed one-line helper must not inherit its complexity score.
Task is limited to parsing code, while the proposed target edits an unrelated style file; drift is a model finding, not a production hard block.
An in-scope parsing change has an inert placeholder literal and environment-reference text, neither of which is a credential; the lexical denylist is not a general credential detector.
